snippet.title: Whiskerwood - Launch Trailer | Cats & Mice City-Builder Game
snippet.description:
In Whiskerwood, establish a colony for your industrious mice in uncharted territory under the oppressive paw of their cat overlords in Whiskerwood - a city builder featuring complex simulations through terraforming and combating climate, supply chain management dealing with over 40 commodities, and the age-old rivalry between cat and mouse.

Whiskerwood is OUT NOW in Early Access on Steam, GOG, Epic, and Microsoft Game Store!

➤ OUT NOW ON STEAM: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2489330/Whiskerwood/
➤ GOG: https://www.gog.com/game/whiskerwood
➤ EPIC: https://store.epicgames.com/p/whiskerwood-461627
➤ Microsoft Game Store: https://www.microsoft.com/store/productid/9NM2T0DMP4XV
